description: Runtime loading of modules exposed by another independently deployed build (Webpack 5, Rspack, `@module-federation/enhanced`).
A remote `exposes` modules through an entry file; a host declares `remotes` and imports them lazily. One build can be both.
A dependency such as React negotiated at runtime so only one copy loads; required for hooks and context, and it couples version upgrades.
A framework-agnostic micro-frontend router: `registerApplication` with `activeWhen`, and apps exporting `bootstrap`, `mount` and `unmount`.
Monorepo tools (Nx, Turborepo) order tasks by dependencies, hash their inputs and replay cached outputs locally or from a remote cache.
Running tasks only for projects changed since a base commit and the projects that depend on them.
A versioned package of tokens, components and guidelines with an owning team, changelogs, deprecations and codemods (Polaris, Atlassian, Carbon).
